reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: I have done this program twice, both times started very overweight (like 290 lbs) and limited running. I stuck with the program, forced myself through it, and was able to run a half marathon at <10 min miles by the end - I also lost a ton of weight. My cross training days were weight lifting, stair master, and/or peloton

reviews.title: Great help and motivation
reviews.text: It was great having the voice telling me when to start and stop.

reviews.title: Great start
reviews.text: I liked how user friendly it was while running. I appreciate the features that are available for free.

reviews.title: BEST. RUNNING. APP. EVERRR!!
reviews.text:
I first used the 5k version and it got me into running 5k without stopping and went from a 1hr PR to a 34min PR! 
Now I’m training for my first half marathon and I know I’m going to kill it thanks to this training plan.
The 5k is free and it got me here, the subscription is completely worth it for this one! 
You can play your own music no interruptions, it doesn’t have annoying ads, connects directly with your Apple Watch and strava! I can’t recommend this app enough!
I got all my cousins running now with the 5k plan 😂🩷

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: So easy to use

reviews.title: Good program, but lacks appropriate reminders and cross training
reviews.text: I appreciate the running break down. It has kept me running steady. Some days I run and later on I get a push notification asking me to lace up my shoes- no! I ran already. As for cross training- I would like to be able to click as complete as it sounds pretty funny in a cross training class to have get ready to run said out loud from the online trainer. There are some bugs to work out.

reviews.title: This app made me believe I can run!
reviews.text: I had never believed I could run, now I walk and run confidently.  Thank you - the music helps too!

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Downloaded this years ago and I come back to it every time I fall out of shape. Easy to follow and good motivation.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: I love the timer however my runs are not syncing and I am unable to connect to my watch

reviews.title: Greatest training plan
reviews.text: I started with the 5K trainer and have worked my way up to the 13.1. Ran my first half this past December and did it in 2:13. I recommend this for anyone wanting to get started

reviews.title: Good motivation
reviews.text: Sometimes you need a little motivation and this app does that. Alerts to workout. Pep while working out. And you can take pics when you finish. At the end you have a large collection to show you the hard work you’ve accomplished.

reviews.title: Why is this a subscription?
reviews.text: I remember paying for the running app library a few years ago. I could probably restore my purchase and get some lesser version of the paid subscription mess they’re pushing now, but I don’t want to support an app that refuses to let its backers own the software they think they’re paying for. The inability to permanently disable the flock of obnoxious tracking requests every time I start a workout is pushing me out of using this company’s apps entirely. I never thought Nike would have a better running app than Zen. I’m sad the company went this way.

reviews.title: I have purchased this app, now have to subscribe
reviews.text: This app used to be a purchase, not subscription. I already paid for the app and should not have to pay a subscription fee just because i have not used it in a long time.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Love how easy and smooth is the training for my half marathon race and also the mix music albums

reviews.title: I love it
reviews.text: Honestly, I am a newer runner. I have done 5ks, a 10K, and now my first half. The app works, gives you a plan, it is very reinforcing in its set up, and honestly gets you to your goal. Give it a try!

reviews.title: Works if you work
reviews.text: I definitely recommend doing the 5k and 10K apps first. But as long as you do it to the best of your ability this will work.

reviews.title: My favorite running app.
reviews.text: I started with the Zen Labs C25K (which I’ve done for 10+ years every racing season) then decided to give this one a try. I love that I can play music on any app in the background and it talks over it to tell me when to start/stop running/walking. I love the warm up and cool down. I also love that it automatically links with my Apple Watch and Apple Fitness without me having to do anything.

reviews.title: Best app
reviews.text: I started with the 5k and have been working my way up. It breaks it down in a way that makes the distances feel obtainable! A great app!

reviews.title: Easy to use
reviews.text: I love that this app makes it easy to achieve my goal. I hit start and follow instructions. I’ve used the c25k app and liked it just as much.

reviews.title: Great workout
reviews.text: Appreciated the prompts and tracking

reviews.title: Best trainer
reviews.text: Love this, have worked up from c25k, great app

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: Love this app. I’m in my late fifties, so no spring chicken. And as a beginner runner, it’s been a huge help in giving me structure and motivation in my training. It has made what at one time seemed overwhelming - running a half marathon - into a manageable and doable challenge. Def recommended.

reviews.title: Great partner!
reviews.text: This app makes a great run partner as I have restarted my own running journey after a few years of being out of it!

reviews.title: Trying out
reviews.text: Thanks for letting me try the app before purchase

reviews.title: Great for older runners
reviews.text: Took a break from running due to cancer for a few years. Gained some weight, lost some fitness, but this made it easy to get back into the swing of things.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Great way to start your cardio

reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: The best running app out there! Hands down! You will be glad you invest it in your wellbeing. 😊❤️

reviews.title: Love being coached
reviews.text: The walk run intervals are so helpful. Like that I can listen to my own music in the background. Also love the visual summary at the end

reviews.title: Keeps Getting Better!!!
reviews.text: Love this app.  I used Zen Labs C25K when I quit smoking, 10K Trainer to lose weight, and now I'm on the Half.  This program is idiot proof and I actually look forward to the daily inspirations.  It works beautifully with my playlists and I just won't run without it.  Thanks for a constant awesome!!!

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.text: It works very good

reviews.title: Great App
reviews.text: Easy to use and great way to buildup for the half marathon, used it last year and using it again for another one.
I love 13.1 it helped me so much in the past and now again for my first half marathon

reviews.title: App review
reviews.text: When I turned 40, I decided to run a marathon. This app was amazing because it allowed me to stay on pace for my race and meet my goals. Love that it trains based on the Galloway (run/walk) method, because it didn’t feel overwhelming to train for such a big race. My goal was to finish so I wasn’t extremely focused on times.
Good

reviews.title: Best marathon training app out there!
reviews.text: This app is easy to use and really prepares you to do well and be ready for face day.

reviews.title: Great run
reviews.text: I like this app better than the other apps that I’ve trained with. Incorporating the walks really helped me to push myself during the runs. Great app

reviews.title: Setting Goals
reviews.text: Absolutely love this App!!  Running is such a mental game and this app helps me to accomplish daily goals to culminate in my end goal. It has helped me to stay positive because I am able to succeed along the way.

reviews.title: Excellent first workout!
reviews.text: I just started this app today and I liked it a lot. I wish the music went at the same pace as the interval (faster on jog intervals, etc) but that’s a minor complaint. Excited to get to 13.1 😎

reviews.title: Great program
reviews.text: I’ve been trying to train for another half marathon for years and always end up hurt from overtraining. This has given me a simple program I can follow and I feel great while reaching my goals.

reviews.title: Slightly buggy tracking
reviews.text: I enjoy the pacing of the training in this app, however, I have had a few runs where no distance is tracked (even though the route is still reflected). I am not sure what my overall distance run is since some of the runs do not track accurate distance. I’d like this app a bit more if I could have all of my run distances tracked.

reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text:
This app is just a timer really, but it’s simplistic no frills design so a feature not a bug. if you want the most basic timer for jogging ever this is it.

 Bought this app and another from them. Sometime later my app stopped working and they trying to charge a monthly fee for something I already bought outright. 

Made a number of attempts to solve this with support but was brushed off after providing proof of purchase. They kept offering me free trials instead a refund of even better .. restoring what I paid for already.

reviews.title: Good training for first day
reviews.text: I like the first day pace

reviews.title: Never actually get to run!
reviews.text: I used the C25k and 10K apps and had great success. Each starts slow but eventually you are running for the full time (other than warm up/ cool down). I expected the half marathon app to be similar, but it has you do a run-walk repeat all the way up until the race. This is useless to me as someone who can already run a 10K. Instantly deleting and unsubscribing!

reviews.title: Small complaint
reviews.text: My Apple Watch didn’t sync with the Apple app during the run so I couldn’t pause or check stats during the run

reviews.title: Constant bombardment to spend more money
reviews.text: The workout progression and everything is great. The problem is, I signed up for the pro version of the app, but in the middle of my workout and every time I open the app it keeps prompting me to sign up for Zen Unlimited or whatever. I think it’s ridiculous that the paid version keeps asking for more subscription sign ups. Sure, the free version I can see the constant advertisement, but in the paid version, it’s really annoying. Unsubscribing and deleting.

reviews.title: disappointed
reviews.text: I bought the bundle pack many years ago. I used to be able to use all four (5K, 10K, Half Marathon, and Marathon) without an issue. Now all of a sudden I have to purchase the pro to use the Half and Full Marathon. What a waste.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: Simple to use and the C2half has been exactly what I’ve been looking for.

reviews.title: Moving on to half marathon
reviews.text: This app helped me to get through a 5k and a 10k. I am moving on to a half marathon this fall! 🏃🏾

reviews.title: Where did my app go?!
reviews.text: So I have used this app along with the marathon, c25k and 10K apps for years. Now when I try to open any of these apps on my iPhone 12 Pro (which I had no issues with doing before) I get a white screen and nothing comes up. I have a strong WiFi connection and stable internet when I’m trying to use this app and nothing! Very frustrating when trying to plan out a workout schedule for a new 1/2 marathon. I am paying for the subscription for the use of all 4 of these zen lab apps. Why can I not access them now? Starting to feel like I am being scammed by the company. Pay for a subscription but we won’t give you the services you paid for….

reviews.title: Dishonest company!
reviews.text: I paid for this a long time ago and now I have to pay for a subscription  not very trustworthy company.
